registration_steps.value: Visit www.digitalgujarat.gov.in and click New Registration (Citizen).
registration_steps.quote: If u have new user than click below “New Registration (Citizen)” button.

registration_steps.value: Fill in details such as Mobile Number and Email Address, review the Password Policy, enter Captcha, and click Save.
registration_steps.quote: 1. Please fill in the details such as Mobile Number and Email Address.

registration_steps.value: Enter the OTP received on your mobile number and click the Confirm button.
registration_steps.quote: After entering the login details, you will receive an OTP on your mobile number. Please enter the OTP and click the Confirm button.

registration_steps.value: Provide consent and complete Aadhaar OTP-based authentication for e-KYC and personal information.
registration_steps.quote: For Aadhaar OTP-based authentication, please read all the details, check the checkbox, and click the Accept & Continue button.

registration_steps.value: Fill in address information manually or fetch address from Aadhaar, Property Tax, Electricity Bill, or Gas Connection.
registration_steps.quote: Please fill in the details then click the Save Address Details button.

registration_steps.value: Add family member details either by fetching from Ration Card or through manual entry.
registration_steps.quote: Note : Family member details can be added either from the Ration Card OR by Manual entry.

registration_steps.value: Click Save Profile Details & eSign and complete the Aadhaar OTP verification to finalize the profile.
registration_steps.quote: Once family members are added, you will return to the previous screen. To delete a member, click ‘Remove’. After verifying all details, click ‘Save Profile Details & eSign’.
